subject: Rimuldar
text: To reach Rimuldar from the Swamp Cave, cross the swamp to solid ground, go south-east then south past the second mountain range, wrap around them to the south, and cross the desert strip surrounded by water.

evidence.quote: After leaving the cave, cross the swamp to solid ground. Heal yourself. Go south-east, then south....After you pass the second mountain range, wrap around them to the south, and cross the desert strip surrounded by water. This is Rimuldar, the fabled key-town.

subject: Rimuldar Key Shop
text: The key salesman in Rimuldar is found by hugging the moat around the top towards the back of town and entering the building next to a man in a green shirt.

evidence.quote: You will also find the keys to the north: Hug the moat, going around the top, towards the back of the town. Once there, you will see a guy with a green shirt next to a building. Go in, and you will find the key salesman.

subject: Rimuldar Key Shop
text: You can purchase up to six keys from the key salesman in Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Go in, and you will find the key salesman. Go ahead and buy all the keys you can, which should be six.

subject: Broadsword
text: The weapon shop in Rimuldar sells the Broadsword for 1500-G.

evidence.quote: Then, head on over to the weapon shop and check out the new hardware. Yow will notice the Broadsword(1500-G), and the Magic Armor(7700-G).

subject: Magic Armor
text: The weapon shop in Rimuldar sells the Magic Armor for 7700-G.

evidence.quote: Yow will notice the Broadsword(1500-G), and the Magic Armor(7700-G).

subject: Goldman
text: Defeating a Goldman yields around 200-G.

evidence.quote: Eventually, we will go an fight the Goldman, a, well, man made of gold. You can get around 200-G for killing this guy!

subject: Howard
text: Howard is behind one of the locked doors in Rimuldar and reveals that a magic item is four steps south of the bath in Kol.

evidence.quote: There are only two doors in Rimuldar. Behind one is the famous Howard, and he will tell you that, four steps south of the bath in Kol (you know, the one that cures rheumatism), you will find a magic item.

subject: Rimuldar
text: Behind a locked door in Rimuldar you can find wings, which normally cost 70-G.

evidence.quote: Behind the other door, you will find wings. Don't open the doors (unless you absolutely HAVE to see for your self) because the wings only cost 70-G, and two keys cost 106-G.

subject: Rimuldar Inn
text: The inn in Rimuldar costs 55-G to stay.

evidence.quote: Be sure you are sufficently healed (you may wish to use the Rimuldar Inn(55-G)), and leave the South Island the way you came.

subject: Swamp Cave
text: To navigate back northward through the Swamp Cave, follow east, north, west, then north.

evidence.quote: Once in the Swamp Cave, follow these directions to get back northward: east, north, west, north.

subject: Kol
text: Searching the area four steps south of the bath in Kol yields the Fairie's Flute.

evidence.quote: Stop by Kol, and search the area four steps south of the bath. Pick up the Fairie's Flute (hey, didn't we hear about a Golem who hates music? And that Fairie's can put things to sleep? Hmmm......), and head to Tantegel.

subject: Tantegel Castle
text: Behind a locked door on the north side of Tantegel Castle is 39-G and a man who says brave people do not steal.

evidence.quote: Behind the door that you will pass is a guy saying that brave people don't steal (HAHAHA) and 39-G.

subject: Tantegel Castle Barrier
text: Each diagonal damage barrier space in Tantegel Castle inflicts 20 Hit Points of damage.

evidence.quote: Well, don't enter at all (each space of the diagonal stuff takes out 20 Hit Points), for I will tell you what the guy back there says.

subject: Tantegel Castle Cellar
text: In the cellar reached by going east around the lady south of the key salesman and heading south, an old man gives a chest containing the Stones of Sunlight.

evidence.quote: Go near that lady just south of the key salesman, and go around her to the east....Go south, and you will find a little stairway leading down to... the cellar! Go down, and the guy will say he's been waiting for you. Take his chest and find the Stones of Sunlight.

subject: Goldman
text: The Goldman can be fought in the second set of hills south of Rimuldar.

evidence.quote: Then, you can head to the second set of hills to the south of Rimuldar, and fight... The Goldman!!

subject: Goldman
text: When fighting the Goldman, you must cast the Sleep spell; he hits for around 15 Hit Points and takes about 6 hits to defeat.

evidence.quote: When you fight him, there is one thing you MUST do: USE THE SLEEP SPELL! Otherwise, he will completely kick your butt. He hits for around 15 Hit Points, and you will have to hit him around 6 times to kill him.

subject: Stopspell
text: The Stopspell spell is acquired at Level 10.

evidence.quote: Also, once you get Level 10 (you can now hunt around on the little island south of Rimuldar) and the Stopspell spell, you might want to try it on the Warlocks.

subject: Wyvern
text: Wyverns are found far to the south on the little island, are susceptible to the Sleep spell, and pay out over 80-G.

evidence.quote: Wyverns can be found very far south, on the little island. They hit hard, but the Sleep spell works pretty well on them. They pay out over 80-G.

subject: Green Dragon
text: Inside the Swamp Cave, the Green Dragon is located through a small opening reached by going east and weaving south without returning to the western aisle.

evidence.quote: Head back to the Swamp Cave. Once in, use your Radiant spell (finally) and light up the area around you. Go east, and then weave your way to the south (without returning to the long aisle to the west) until you come to a small opening much like a doorway. Heal yourself, and enter. It's... A GREEN DRAGON!

subject: Green Dragon
text: The Green Dragon has about 60 Hit Points, strikes for 20 to 30 damage, and should immediately be put to sleep.

evidence.quote: Immediately put him to sleep; if it doesn't work, back out, heal, and return. The Dragon has about 60 Hit Points, and every hit you make will count for a little under 10. You have 62 Hit Points, and the Dragon hits for 20 to 30.

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: After defeating the Green Dragon in Swamp Cave, walk south, open the door, and agree to take Princess Gwaelin to Tantegel.

evidence.quote: After defeating the Dragon, walk around to the south and open the door. Speak to the lovely Princess, who will ask you to take her to Tanegel. Say yes (if you say no, she will say 'But you must' and ask again).

subject: Princess Gwaelin
text: Returning Princess Gwaelin to the King at Tantegel Castle grants Gwaelin's Love, which reveals your coordinates in Alefgard and remaining Experience Points to the next level.

evidence.quote: Take her to the castle, and bring her to the King. He will be grateful, and Gwaelin will give you her love. You can use her love to figure out where you are in Alefgard, and how many Experience Points until you get your next Level

subject: Garinham
text: Chests on the east side of Garinham contain a torch, an herb, and 15-G.

evidence.quote: Once in Garinham, go to the east side of town and go through the door....The chests contain a torch, an herb, and 15-G.

subject: Grave of Garin
text: To enter the Grave of Garin, push against the northern darkness wall above the room containing two guards in east Garinham.

evidence.quote: Push on it above the room with the two guards in it. Follow the path to the old man, whom will tell you not to go in for the Silver Harp is inside. Don't listen to him; that guy north of Kol needs it, remember? Well, head on in.

subject: Grave of Garin Level 1
text: On level 1 of the Grave of Garin, three chests along the northern wall contain 26-G and an Herb.

evidence.quote: Follow the wall to the west, and you will soon find three chests, containing 26-G and an Herb.

subject: Grave of Garin Level 3
text: The Silver Harp is found on Level 3 of the Grave of Garin by bypassing dead-end staircases and taking the southern wall stairs down.

evidence.quote: This is a four level dungeon; the prize we are searching for is on level 3....Instead, follow the outside wall to the south, passing the first stairway you come to. Go down the next one. Follow the hallway north, go east at the split, and go down the stairs. Go around the wall in the middle of the room to the stairs on the other side, and go back up. Here you will find the Silver Harp.

subject: Grave of Garin
text: The Grave of Garin also contains the Cursed Belt.

evidence.quote: If you want to explore around a little more you can, but the only other item here is the Cursed Belt, which you really have no need for.

subject: Old Man North of Kol
text: Giving the Silver Harp to the man north of Kol rewards you with the Staff of Rain, after which he disappears.

evidence.quote: Pick up a free healing, and then go to the man north of Kol to collect the Staff of Rain (ooh, another piece of the Rainbow puzzle!). Don't worry; after you talk to him, he's supposed to disappear.

subject: Magic Armor
text: Equipping the Magic Armor restores 1 Hit Point for every four steps taken.

evidence.quote: The thing that is so special about the Magic Armor is that for every four steps you take, you gain 1 Hit Point!

subject: Return
text: The Return spell is learned at Level 13 and warps you back to Tantegel Castle for 8 Magic Points.

evidence.quote: Once you get the grand total of a little under 8000-G, you should also either have or almost have reached Level 13. With this level comes one of the most useful spells: Return. This spell will take you back to Tantegel Castle - no matter where you are, as long as you have the necessary 8 Magic Points.

subject: Brecconary
text: Fairy Water can be purchased in Brecconary to help keep enemies away.

evidence.quote: You may wish to buy a bottle of Fairy Water in Brecconary for this trip. Fairy Water works like bug spray: it helps to keep enemies away, though it doesn't always work too well.

subject: Cantlin
text: To reach Cantlin, head south past the gold-building area across the bridge, cross the desert south to a bridge east, cross it, go north-east, pass the first bridge, cross the next bridge with swamp on the other side, and head south.

evidence.quote: Continue beyond the area I told you to build up gold, across the bridge. Go south across the desert, and keep going south until you come to yet another bridge leading east. Go across, and go north-east. Pass by the first bridge, and cross the next (the one with a little swamp on the other side). Then go south; you will soon find a town surrounded by a wall.

subject: Golem
text: The Golem guards the opening of Cantlin and can be put to sleep during battle by playing the Fairy's Flute.

evidence.quote: In the opening will be the Golem. If you remember correctly, you should use the Fairy's Flute on him to put him to sleep. Fight him; if he awakes, then put him to sleep again. The reward really sucks, but you will gain access to Cantlin.

subject: Erdrick's Token
text: Erdrick's Token is hidden 70 spaces south and 40 spaces east of Tantegel Castle, locatable using Gwaelin's Love.

evidence.quote: A man behind a door and a barrier says to search 70 to the south and 40 to the east of Tantegel. Eventually, you will use Gwaelin's Love to find what's here (Erdrick's Token, to prove you are in the line of Erdrick).

subject: Flame Sword
text: Behind a locked door staffed by two people at desks in Cantlin, the Flame Sword is sold for 9800-G.

evidence.quote: The only door you need to open (though only if you have 9800-G) is the one with two people behind desks. You will buy the Flame Sword here.

subject: Large Shield
text: The Large Shield can be bought in Cantlin for 800-G.

evidence.quote: While you're in the city, you should also buy the Large Shield(800-G).
